subject: How would you like us to teach Shiny?

messages.author: 07082c2b48d8d18a
messages.subject: How would you like us to teach Shiny?
parts:
Hi all,

We're building a Shiny training program, but we want to make sure it is useful. I think everyone on this list has valuable advice that could help shape the training, and I'd like to hear from you.

If you have a moment, please give me your opinions on two questions in the link below. Your answers will be recorded anonymously, but you can also choose to leave your contact information.

Thank you for sharing your advice on how to teach Shiny!

Click on form here:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1cplDIkVR6VLd_AT4V3UZlkf_QquUt8rpmJCWG49UWVs/viewform

Garrett Grolemund
The RStudio Team
